signature_features: light grey panel background #EDEDEF behind the reaction schemes (crops 01 and 02); the product panel (crop 03) is on white
thin navy top edge #00007E on the grey panel (crop 01 only); no navy title bar and no white panel title in any crop
blue circle with white lightning bolt on the arrow for electrolysis (crops 01 and 02; circle #0B17FF)
scale and comparison notes in bold blue #0B17FF (crop 02); the blue 'Chiral auxiliary' note in crop 01 is regular weight
compound labels bold and large, close to atom-label size (crops 01 and 02; crop 01 compound cap height 31 px against 36 px for atom labels)

notes.yield_placement: null: crop 02 puts the multistep yields under the arrow; crop 03 (a product panel, not a reaction scheme) puts its yield under the product label; crop 01 shows no yield. Only one scheme crop shows a placement, so there is no top-level value. The product-panel placement is recorded under figure_types.substrate_scope.
notes.conditions_split: null: crop 01 puts NMP below the arrow with the electrodes and current; crop 02 puts nBu4NBF4 and DMA above the arrow with the other reagents. The two reaction-scheme crops disagree.
notes.substrate_layout: null: only crop 01 shows a plus between two substrates. Crop 02 writes its bromide as a reagent above the arrow and has no plus sign.
notes.show_plus_sign: null: same evidence as substrate_layout; only crop 01 shows a plus sign.
notes.new_bond_color: dark red in both reaction-scheme crops: crop 01 flat sample #8A0108 (the Ar wedge); crop 02 hashed bond #880000 to #8A0108. The Nature product panel (crop 03) uses purple; its bonds are one pixel wide, so no flat sample was taken. The top-level value describes reaction schemes only.
notes.highlight_fill: null: the teal #BBF6F4 box behind the target appears in crop 02 only (68856 pixels, flat). Crops 01 and 03 show no teal. Kept as a one-crop value under figure_types.reaction_scheme.

evidence.observations: grey panel, thin navy top edge, blue lightning electrode icon on arrow, dark red bold wedge for the new C-C bond, blue dots for the auxiliary, bold label 5 with plain (1 eq), reagents above and solvent, electrodes and current below

reaction_scheme.notes: Read from crops 01 and 02. yield_format matches crop 02 (99%, 92%, 65% under the arrow). highlight_fill rests on crop 02 alone: the teal box sits behind the target product 4, and crop 01 has none. Crop 01 shows no yields.

substrate_scope.notes: One crop (03), a grid of approved-drug and candidate structures sharing a glucose core, each with its yield under the product label (88%, with a beta:alpha note). Read from one crop. The yield format matches crop 02. No teal box and no grey panel in this crop.
